newsitem.title: CANADA: Hartmann - Buba not responsible for German growth.
newsitem.headline: Hartmann - Buba not responsible for German growth.

text.p: Bundesbank directorate member Wendelin Hartmann said on Friday that the Bundesbank was not ultimately responsible for economic growth in Germany and that it had done all it could to help facilitate growth.
"What we can do is done. We have done our duty in this context," Hartmann told a conference at the Forex 97 meeting in Toronto.
"The constraints of economic growth are different, they do not lie in the financial environment, they do not lie in the interest rate field, which is the influential area of the Bundesbank," he said.
